services.name: ChannelDispatchRegistry
services.responsibility: Pure (un-guarded) registry mapping ChannelKind -> ChannelDispatchPort adapter; exposes send() and the Wave-21 alias sendMessage(). The marketing-layer canonical router.

services.name: ChannelMessageDispatchService
services.responsibility: Ergonomic facade over ChannelDispatchRegistry: dispatch(workspaceId, channel, to, message, opts) resolves Meta creds once, builds the discriminated ChannelSendInput (via channel-message-dispatch.helpers buildWhatsApp/buildInstagram/buildMessenger/buildFacebook/buildEmail), delegates. Also dispatchTool/createAdDraftTool resolver shims.

services.name: ChannelTransportRegistry
services.responsibility: MindGuard-WRAPPED outbound registry for the agent/inbox/webhook layer. Maps ChannelName -> ChannelTransportProvider, runs send_message policy guard + structured audit, then either delegates to ChannelMessageDispatchService (flag KLOEL_TRANSPORT_CANONICAL_DELEGATE, channels wa/ig/messenger only) OR to the legacy provider.send(). Parallel registry to ChannelDispatchRegistry.

services.name: InstagramChannelTransport / MessengerChannelTransport / TikTokChannelTransport / EmailChannelTransport
services.responsibility: ChannelTransportProvider impls (the legacy guarded providers). Instagram/Messenger re-resolve MetaConnection and re-call InstagramService/MessengerService; Email routes via EmailCampaignService (Resend/SendGrid/env-SMTP); TikTok is an honest-blocked stub. These duplicate, capability-for-capability, the marketing/channels/*-dispatch.adapter classes.
